howToPlay.heading: Training ground
howToPlay.headingEn: Learn the moves before your first mission

steps.title: Your mission
steps.body: Each level gives you a page from a real CAG audit report in English. Your job: make the Hindi perfect, just as CAG publishes it.

steps.title: How you score
steps.body: Five things make your score out of 100: translation quality, time, completion, glossary words and sentence construction. Score 33 or more to win the level's title.

steps.title: Your toolkit
steps.body: Type Roman letters and pick a Hindi suggestion, use the InScript keyboard, or your device's Hindi keyboard. In Level 1 you can also speak. Try it below!

steps.title: Your guide
steps.body: Sahayika is with you in every level. Ask her for a hint, a glossary word or the time left. She'll never give away the answer.

points: Play to gain: appraisal benefit, translation practice and Hindi Pakhwada credits.
Credits: Joining 2 · Trial 3 · Primary 5 · Secondary 15 · Pro 25 = 50
From Level 2, BHASHINI gives you a machine draft. Find its mistakes and fix them.
In Level 1 (Trial) you translate everything yourself.
Stuck on a word? Open the Glossary.
Five things count: translation, time, completion, glossary, sentence construction.
See the ways to write Hindi on the right.
howToPlay.practiceNote: Practice only: nothing here is saved.

rules.heading: Rules of the game
rules.headingEn: Three rules keep it fair for everyone
rules.rule1Body: During a mission you can't leave the page, copy or paste. Leaving is counted and shown on your report card.
rules.rule2Body: Play each level up to three times. Only your best score counts, so a bad try never costs you credits.
rules.rule3Body: Speak-to-type works only in the Trial. From Level 2 you type every word.

journey.allDone: Every level played! Visit the Hall of Fame.

preRound.typingOnly: From now on you type every word. Speaking was only for the Trial.

preRound.fullMeaning: Bring across the full meaning of every part. Leave nothing out.
preRound.threeChances: You have three chances. Your best score counts.
preRound.objTrial: Translate the passage into Hindi from scratch.
preRound.objMain: Check BHASHINI's Hindi draft part by part, fix every mistake, and tick ✓ each part.
preRound.objNumbers: Keep numbers, years and ₹ amounts exactly as they are.

latin_word.en: write proper Hindi words, not English ones.
latin_word.hi: अंग्रेज़ी शब्दों की जगह हिंदी शब्द लिखिए।

missing_danda.en: end every sentence with a full stop (।).
missing_danda.hi: हर वाक्य के अंत में पूर्ण विराम (।) लगाइए।

vowel_sign_start.en: a word should not start with a vowel sign.
vowel_sign_start.hi: कोई शब्द मात्रा से शुरू नहीं होना चाहिए।

repeated_word.en: a word was written twice in a row.
repeated_word.hi: एक शब्द लगातार दो बार लिखा गया है।

unbalanced_bracket.hi: जो कोष्ठक ( ) खोला है, उसे बंद भी कीजिए।

number_missing.en: keep every number from the English page.
number_missing.hi: अंग्रेज़ी पेज का हर अंक अपने अनुवाद में रखिए।

refuseTranslate.en: That part is your job, and I know you can do it! I can give you a hint or a glossary word instead.
refuseTranslate.hi: यह हिस्सा तो आपको ही लिखना है, और आप कर लेंगे! मैं आपको एक इशारा या शब्दावली का शब्द दे सकती हूँ।
